title.narrative: Strengthened institutional capacity of workers' organizations

description.narrative: Trade unions represent and promote workers' interests, with education at the heart of their efforts in Africa, supporting decolonisation and resisting neo-liberal policies. Technological advances and climate change pose new challenges. The ILO's Abidjan Declaration emphasises decent work, skills development and social dialogue. The ITUC Africa's TULDA programme aims to build a regional cadre of trade unionists to defend workers' rights and propose alternatives to neo-liberal policies.
